generator: CDA gap-closure pass (gate blockers: cdaHeaderElement typeId, section-not-in-structure x13, required-section-missing, cda-rad-order empty body)
scope: CDA only. Does not touch FHIR, HL7 v2 or SOAP/XDS.
readMe: Every rule carries provenance. {source:{pageId,quote}} quotes are verbatim rows lifted programmatically from spec-source/pages/<pageId>.json - none were typed by hand.
{source:{sample:...}} means the rule is derived from an official sample because Confluence does not state it.

Three findings contradict assumptions in the brief and are called out explicitly: the NoInfo mechanism is a templateId flag and NOT nullFlavor; cda-rad-order is derivable from Confluence and did NOT need a sample fallback; and the missing Immunization Summary section is a CORRECTION to an existing row, not an addition.

headerModel.orderBasis: HL7 CDA R2 normative ClinicalDocument sequence, confirmed element-by-element against all 16 official CDA samples. No sample contradicts it.

source.quote: 1 | Clinical Document |   |   | /ClinicalDocument |

elements.name: realmCode

source.quote: 1.2 | Realm code | M | [1..1] | ./realmCode | Describing the realm in which this document has been created.SHALL contain the attribute @code set to the fixed value “SA”.

elements.notes: Sample-confirmed: <realmCode code="SA"/> appears exactly once in all 16 samples.

elements.name: typeId

source.quote: <typeId extension="POCD_HD000040" root="2.16.840.1.113883.1.3"/>
source.corroboration: HL7 CDA R2 normative ClinicalDocument element sequence (ANSI/HL7 CDA R2-2005)
source.note: NO Confluence page in the 617-page cached corpus mentions typeId or POCD_HD000040; the string 'POCD_HD000040' returns zero hits. This row therefore carries sample + CDA R2 provenance only, never a Confluence quote.

elements.notes: THE GAP-1 FIX. Identical in all 16 samples, always the 2nd child, immediately after realmCode. Fixed by CDA R2: typeId/@root is the HL7 RIM OID and @extension the POCD_HD000040 document message type. NPHIES adds no constraint, which is why it is missing from the Confluence header table and therefore from the compiled spec.

elements.name: templateId

source.quote: 1.1 | Template indicator | M | [1..*] | ./templateId[1..*] | Template indicator(s) for the particular kind of document.

elements.notes: Max Rpt is [1..*]. Observed 1-2 per document: the nphies document templateId always, plus an IHE/CCD document template where the document type defines one (Laboratory Results, Radiology Results Embedded PDF).

source.quote: 1.3 | Document Identifier | M | [1..1] | ./id | Document identifiers must be unique every time a new version of the document is published.SHALL contain attribute @root, containing an OID based on the root OID of the organization assigned by nphies during onboarding ensuring a unique document identifier.SHALL contain attribute @extension, which contains the local document identifier.

1.4 | Document Type Code | M | [1..1] | ./code | The code specifying the particular kind of document.The Code is specialized by each specific type of document.The attributes @code, @codeSystem and @displayName SHALL be present. The attribute @codeSystemName MAY be present.
1.5 | Title of the document | M | [1..1] | ./title | Represents the title of the document.

elements.name: nphies:documentStatus

source.quote: 1.6 | Document Status (Business/workflow level) | M | [1..1] | ./nphies:documentStatus | SHALL contain one of the following values out of the nphies FHIR Diagnostic Report Status Value Set

elements.notes: NPHIES EXTENSION ELEMENT, not part of CDA R2. Bound to the namespace declared on ClinicalDocument as xmlns:nphies="urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.3.3731.1.2.2.11111111111110" (see page 15925510 row 1). It sits between title and effectiveTime in all 16 samples - the CDA R2 slot occupied by sdtcStatusCode. A validator that enforces the bare CDA R2 sequence will reject every conformant NPHIES document unless it allows this element here.

source.quote: 1.7 | Document creation date and time | M | [1..1] | ./effectiveTime | Signifies the document creation date and time, when the document first came into being.

1.8 | Confidentiality Code | M | 1..1 | ./confidentialityCode | SHALL contain a value out of the "KSA Confidentiality Code" value-set.The attributes @code, @codeSystem and @displayName SHALL be present. The attribute @codeSystemName MAY be present.

elements.name: languageCode

source.quote: 1.9 | Language code | R | [1..1] | ./lanugageCode | Language code of the document.SHALL contain the attribute @code set to a value according to the IETF BCP 47 standard.Examples: ar-SA, en-US, …

elements.notes: UPSTREAM TYPO: the Confluence CDA Element Location cell reads './lanugageCode' (transposed letters). The correct CDA R2 element name is languageCode, which is what all 16 samples carry. Do not propagate the typo into a locator.

source.quote: 1.10 | Document Set Id | M | [1..1] | ./setId | This attribute represents an identifier that is common across all document revisions. It shall be a unique identifier.SHALL contain attribute @root, containing an OID based on the root OID of the organization assigned by nphies during onboarding ensuring a unique document identifier.It is recommended to set it equal to the document id of the first version of a document.
1.11 | Version number | M | [1..1] | ./versionNumber | An integer value used to version successive replacement documents, e.g. “1” for the first version of the document.

source.quote: 7.1 | Legal Authenticator | O | [1..1] | /ClinicalDocument/legalAuthenticator | Data element that represents the legal authenticator of the document.The Clinical Document SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] Legal Authenticator if the document is signed.

correction.name: List of Surgeries
correction.rootCause: Page 53477475 (CDA Body - Immunization Summary) contains an UPSTREAM TYPO. Row 1.6 'List of Surgeries' and row 1.10 'Immunization Serology Coded Results' both cite templateId 2.16.840.1.113883.3.3731.1.210.100.87. The first-pass extractor faithfully captured the typo, so the compiled list holds .87 twice and never holds .210.100.7 - which is why the gate could not resolve it in either Immunization Summary sample. Row 1.6 should read 2.16.840.1.113883.3.3731.1.210.100.7.
correction.whyNotAnAddition: Appending .210.100.7 as a 12th section would leave 2.16.840.1.113883.3.3731.1.210.100.87 declared twice and would invent a section the spec never defines. The defect is a wrong value in an existing row, so the fix is to correct that row in place. The section count stays 11.

additions.name: Laboratory Order Specialty Section
additions.loincNote: No fixed LOINC. The section code mirrors the parent Laboratory Specialty Section code, drawn from the 'Laboratory Department' value-set (18723-7 Hematology Studies and 18725-2 Microbiology in the sample).
additions.nesting: NESTED, not a sibling. Path: /ClinicalDocument/component/structuredBody/component/section[templateId='...105.8']/component/section[templateId='...105.14']. The gate flattened the section tree and compared against a flat 2-entry list, so a nested section read as missing.
additions.rationale: 105.14 is the Laboratory Order Specialty Section, declared on page 17695242. A Laboratory Results document embeds the originating order's section inside each Laboratory Specialty Section. The official sample marks this explicitly with the comment 'AS DERIVED FROM THE LABORATORY ORDER' immediately above each occurrence - exactly parallel to the way a Radiology Results document embeds the Radiology Order Section (2.16.840.1.113883.3.3731.1.204.34).
additions.confidenceReason: The IDENTITY of 105.14 is high-confidence (page 17695242 declares it, and page 17596837 row 1.2 makes it the top-level section of cda-lab-order). The EMBEDDING inside 105.8 in a Results document is derived from the sample alone: page 23199954 (Laboratory Specialty Section) lists rows 2.2-2.8 and declares NO sub-section, so Confluence does not document this nesting. Cardinality R2 [0..1] is inferred from the sample (one per specialty section, both present) and is the least-risky reading; a tool should warn, not error, on its absence.

oidCollisions.why: A section templateId OID is NOT globally unique in this spec. Two sections in ONE radiology document share an OID and are told apart only by parent section and LOINC code.
oidCollisions.identityRule: Identify a CDA section by the tuple (parentTemplateId, templateId, code) - never by templateId alone. Resolving by OID alone will silently accept a Key Images section where a Request section belongs.

noInfoVariantRule.howItWorks: A section with no available information keeps its normal templateId list and APPENDS one extra templateId whose root is the section's own nphies OID with '.1' suffixed. Its <text> is the literal narrative 'No information available' and it carries ZERO <entry> elements.
noInfoVariantRule.notNullFlavor: CORRECTION TO A COMMON ASSUMPTION: NoInfo documents do NOT use nullFlavor on sections. Measured across the three NoInfo samples, the whole document contains only 2 nullFlavor attributes and both are on custodian/telecom and custodian/addr, never on a section. Every no-info section is flagged by the .1 templateId instead. A validator looking for section/@nullFlavor will find nothing and wrongly pass or wrongly fail.

immunizationRecommendationsRuling.gateFinding: required-section-missing: section "Immunization Recommendations" is R in cda-immunization-card but absent from the official sample (nphies Immunization Card v4.9beta1 NoInfo.xml).
immunizationRecommendationsRuling.question: (a) correct, because NoInfo variants legitimately omit sections, or (b) a mis-extracted usage?
immunizationRecommendationsRuling.answer: NEITHER. The compiled usage R [1..1] is CORRECTLY extracted, and NoInfo variants do NOT legitimately omit sections. The official NoInfo sample is itself defective.
why: (b) is ruled out: page 53379828 row 1.3 states Immunization Recommendations is R [1..1]. The compiled value matches the source exactly, so nothing was mis-extracted.

(a) is ruled out: page 53379840 defines the NoInfo mechanism for this very document and says the section is still PRESENT, carrying a special templateId and the narrative 'No information available'. Only the ENTRY requirement is waived - 'In case the section would “require” entry elements (specified as [M] or [R] in the chapter where it is specified), this constraint is ignored.' Nothing waives the SECTION requirement.

The sibling on-demand documents prove the intended behaviour: Immunization Summary NoInfo keeps all 10 sections and iEHR Summary NoInfo keeps all 12, each flagged. Immunization Card NoInfo keeps only 1 of its 2.
Page 16744968 row 47.3 defines the no-info flag for this exact section - 2.16.840.1.113883.3.3731.1.210.100.89.1 - which would be pointless if the section could simply be dropped.
immunizationRecommendationsRuling.actionForTheTool: KEEP usage R [1..1] for Immunization Recommendations in cda-immunization-card. An HIS omitting this section should be told it is missing. Report the official sample as non-conformant rather than relaxing the rule to match it - relaxing it would teach every onboarding HIS to emit an incomplete Immunization Card.
